title: Unit equation for the canonical finite scalar open comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, an open immersion j:X→Y, any completed integral derived object K on X, and n≥0. Let q=integralFiniteScalarPull(j,n), the normalized scalar/pullback comparison defined from scalarPull and the published constant-ring presentation. Let t_K be finiteReductionIso(Y,n) inverse at ringedOpen(j)(K), followed by openComparison for reduction modulo exponent n+1, the derived finiteOpenIso(j,n), and finite extension by zero of finiteReductionIso(X,n) at K. Then scalar reduction at X of the actual integral open unit at K, followed by q at ringedOpen(j)(K) and finite pullback of t_K, equals the actual finiteOpenAdj(j,n) unit at scalar reduction of K. No strict-system Operations or RealizationModel is involved.

Naturality of its unit, the scalarPull unit formula, naturality of the restriction/pullback square, and the scalar-mate unit equation reduce it to the open inverse-mate unit equation. Cancel the comparison and its inverse. This proves coefficientOpen_unit for any compatible change, without any flatness condition.

Their naturality cancels both scalar-presentation factors and gives the statement verbatim.

theorem integralOpenScalarUnitSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (K : Integral l E X) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_exact j
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).1
    letI := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_exact j
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).2.1
    letI := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_exact j
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).2.2
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).map ((ringedOpenAdj l E j).unit.app K) ≫
      (integralFiniteScalarPull l E j n).hom.app ((ringedOpen l E j).obj K) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n j).map
        ((PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E Y n).inv.app ((ringedOpen l E j).obj K) ≫
          (PurCompactSupport.openComparison
            (PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) j).app K ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
            (PurCompactSupport.finiteOpenIso l E n j)).hom.app
              ((pbcDerivedExtend (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1)
                (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) X)).obj K) ≫
          (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E X n).hom.app K)) =
    (finiteOpenAdj l E j n).unit.app ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)
